code='''def transform(grid):
    n=len(grid)
    rows=[r[0] for r in grid]
    # Horizontal bands encode a repeating vertical color sequence.
    # Select the shortest period consistent with all non-background rows.
    period=n
    for p in range(1,n+1):
        if all(v==0 or rows[i%p]==0 or rows[i%p]==v for i,v in enumerate(rows)):
            # require at least one repeated known constraint to avoid trivial overfit
            if p<n:
                period=p; break
    seq=[None]*period
    for i,v in enumerate(rows):
        if v!=0 and seq[i%period] is None: seq[i%period]=v
    # Unknown positions remain background.
    return [[(seq[i%period] if seq[i%period] is not None else 0)]*n for i in range(n)]
'''; open(p,'w').write(code); ns={}; exec(code,ns); g=[[0]*10 for _ in range(10)]; vals=[0,0,9,1,4,6,7,6,0,0]; g=[[v]*10 for v in vals]; out=ns['transform'](g); print([r[0] for r in out]);
